messages:
sami: Quick q — during the canary rollout for session-cache v2 (traffic slice = 5%), who is authorized to press the emergency-off button if latency or error rate spikes? Need the exact names/groups, audit path, and what telemetry tags to include.
kevin: Oncall + eng-platform emergency group. We keep the ACL narrow: `group:eng-oncall`, `group:eng-platform-leads`. Nobody from PM/product can flip.
claire: to add: eng-sre escalation (pagerduty) is required to approve if more than 10% user impact. For immediate mitigation (<10%) oncall can flip.
ryan: where do the audit entries land? CloudTrail? Kibana?
opsbot: Audit event written to internal audit stream: `audit.events.killswitch` (ELK + longterm archived to s3:/redwood-audit/kill-switch/). Event payload includes: actor, flag_name, scope, reason, request_id.
kevin: quick cli check: ``redwoodctl auth can-flip --principal sami --flag session-cache-v2`` returns `true/false`. After flip we emit `event_id` you can search in Kibana with `event_id:XYZ`.
sami: ok — so procedure if I flip: 1) post reason + expected impact in thread, 2) @eng-sre page, 3) paste event_id and request_id, 4) leave flag off until we have 2 engineers + 1 SRE confirm stability.
claire: correct. add :rotating_light: — always include the cause and mitigation steps. Also attach the canary config snapshot (`/configs/canaries/session-cache-v2.json`).
ryan: note for telemetry: tag with `rollout_id`, `canary_slice`, `actor`, `manually_disabled=true`. That lets Optimize correlate regressions.
deploy-bot: Auto-fallback configured: when flag disabled we route to session-cache v1 sharded pool for 1h then re-evaluate. If you need longer, set `manual_bypass=true` and spike the TTL.
kevin: can someone add the explicit list of people who currently have perm? I can run an IAM export.
claire: I will update runbook with names and the CLI snippet. tagging kevin for the IAM export and @ryan for telemetry tags.
sami: thanks — please post the runbook link here once done. I want something I can paste in the oncall checklist.
kevin: IAM export scheduled, will post in ~30m: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hot-exit-protocol>
opsbot: Reminder: any manual flip triggers a mandatory postmortem if uptime impact > 15% within 24h.
sami: ack. I'll note this in the canary playbook.
claire: done — runbook updated with names, CLI, and audit search examples. Link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hot-exit-protocol#session-cache-v2>.
sami: perfect, closing loop. Thanks everyone :+1:
